verdict.rationale: Only community evidence suggests Algolia uses per-unit pricing: one user describes a 'price per search model', and another describes record limits. The pack contains no first-party pricing page, so there is no published rate card to predict costs from. One user also reports that sort-by replica indexes multiplied record usage (30K records became 150K), which makes advance cost estimates harder. Missing for 10: first-party published per-unit rates (per search/record), plan tiers or a pricing calculator, and documentation of how replicas count toward billing.
